about.title: Private Egypt Tours,
about.description: We're a Cairo-based tour operator. We run private day tours and custom multi-day trips covering the Giza Pyramids, Cairo, Luxor, Aswan, Nile cruises, and Abu Simbel. No shared buses, no rushed schedules. Just you, a knowledgeable local guide, and the places you actually want to see.
about.feature1: Private Tours, No Shared Group Buses
about.approachText: We built JES around the opposite of what frustrates travelers: fixed prices before you book, no surprises on the day, and guides who are there for you — not for a commission.

homeAbout.title: Private Egypt Tours,
homeAbout.titleHighlight: Planned by a Local Tour Operator in Cairo
homeAbout.description: JES Egypt Tours is a tour operator based in Cairo. A private Egypt tour with us means your own licensed Egyptologist guide, a private air-conditioned vehicle, hotel pickup and drop-off, and a schedule you can change on the day. We run [private day tours](/en/egypt-day-tours) and custom multi-day [Egypt tour packages](/en/egypt-tour-packages) across Giza, Cairo, Luxor, Aswan, Abu Simbel and the Nile, with no shared buses and no forced shopping stops.
homeAbout.feature1: Private tours, no shared group buses
homeAbout.approachText: The price is fixed in writing before you book, nothing changes on the day, and your guide works for you, not for a commission.

whyChooseUs.title: Why Book a Private Egypt Tour with JES?
whyChooseUs.subtitle: A Cairo-based tour operator planning private tours for travelers who want to see Egypt at their own pace.
whyChooseUs.card1Desc: Our guides are licensed by the Egyptian Ministry of Tourism. They explain the history and context on site, and you can choose a guide in English, German, Italian or Spanish.
whyChooseUs.card2Desc: Every booking is one party. Your guide and a private air-conditioned car are yours for the day, which leaves room for questions, longer stops and a pace that suits your group.
whyChooseUs.card3Title: Cairo-Based, Not Just a Booking Page
whyChooseUs.card3Desc: We plan your trip from Cairo, not from an office abroad. You talk directly to the people arranging it, and someone is on the ground if plans need to change.
whyChooseUs.card4Title: A Flexible Day, Built Around You
whyChooseUs.card4Desc: Want longer at the [Valley of the Kings](/en/luxor-west-bank-tour)? Skip a stop that doesn't interest you? Tell your guide at breakfast and we adjust. Shopping stops only happen if you ask for them.
whyChooseUs.card5Title: Pay by Card or Bank Transfer
whyChooseUs.card5Desc: We accept credit and debit cards and international bank transfers. Payment terms are confirmed in writing before you book, and our [payment and cancellation policy](/en/payment-cancellation-policy) is public.
whyChooseUs.card6Desc: [Send us your dates](/en/contact) and what you want to see. We reply with a clear plan and a confirmed price, and you commit to nothing until you are happy with it. Support runs 24/7.
